title.text: Shorts on the inner display, held sideways

split.text: The split costs the clip nothing. Sideways on the inner display, a 9:16 clip at full height is about 416 dp of its half's 490. What the clip gives up is chrome: its name and the six-glyph rail move into the panel, so nothing sits on the picture. Tap the clip to pause; swiping up and down still changes clips.

upnext.text: Up next is the pager's own order, four across. Tap a clip to jump to it; ✕ skips it until the next reshuffle, with Undo. The folder chips replace the Play from sheet, and Shuffle and Auto-advance move off the rail into this header.

strip.text: The strip is the clip's timeline. Sideways it replaces the 3 dp progress edge, so there is one timeline, not two. Tapping a frame jumps there without pausing. Pausing — a tap on the clip — brings up Make a poster, which opens the existing poster editor on that moment. Frame-by-frame stepping already lives there, so the panel doesn't repeat it.

decided.text: Decided 28 Sep: the six glyphs live only in the panel. Up next labels each clip by its folder. No half-folded layout — the phone is used fully open or fully closed, so this split is only for the inner display held sideways.
